name: How do I choose the right energy-efficient windows for my home in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right energy-efficient windows for my home in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting energy-efficient windows in Southern California, consider factors like the U-factor and Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC). A lower U-factor indicates better insulation, which is beneficial for both heating and cooling. A lower SHGC is crucial in our climate to minimize unwanted heat gain from the sun, keeping your home cooler. Look for windows with a good visible transmittance (VT) for natural light, and consider features like Low-E coatings tailored for warm climates. Vinyl or fiberglass frames offer good insulation and durability. We can help you select options that balance performance, aesthetics, and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose windows with low U-factor and SHGC for Southern California's climate to minimize heat transfer and gain. Consider Low-E coatings, frame material, and visible transmittance.
